name: OPSD-PL
notes: ENTSO-E PL system load (OPSD time_series 60min, PL_load_actual_entsoe_transparency) + ERA5 weather (Open-Meteo). aux column holds the TSO's own published day-ahead load forecast (PL_load_forecast_entsoe_transparency, coverage 99.9%). exogenous-series rules: (1) a solar/wind series is dropped if its raw data has any single internal gap longer than 720 h (30 d); (2) then dropped if <50% present over the load span (v1). generation columns kept: {'wind': 'PL_wind_onshore_generation_actual (max internal gap 0 h)'}. dropped: [solar=PL_solar_generation_actual (8.3% present < 50%)]. missing cells interpolated: 0 (per channel {}; linear up to 6 h, then ffill/bfill).
